`Imputed_multilateral_shares.xlsx` has the layout of the OECD workbook (`webfs.oecd.org/climate/Imputed_multilateral_shares.xlsx`) with every sheet deleted except `NOTES`, `2020`, `2022-draft`, `2023` and `2024`. The sheet set, merged headers, agency names and abbreviations, methodology labels and the `-` placeholders are real. Every total and share is invented; the shares in a row keep the workbook's arithmetic (the objective columns add to the overall share), and the workbook's author and sensitivity-label properties are removed.
